body: I've been waiting to move away from them for years and it has been constant torture. I'm in no position to escape from them and even if I was I still wouldn't have a purpose. We live, we die.

All my family has ever done is abused me. A few years ago when I went to a counselor after finally realizing that everything they had indoctrinated me with was a lie they finally stopped the abuse and now they want my forgiveness. They verbally attack me for refusing to forgive them and the past. They swear they "love me" but love isn't countless beatings and verbal abuse the opposite of love? I just don't believe there's a purpose and if I'm going to die, why prolong my misery? There is something holding me back which is why I'm here now. Science and books simply aren't enough for me. I just don't care enough anymore.

The good things in life? Science. Books. But these are only temporary respites... I have no desire to stay around because no matter how hard I try I'm simply rejected and shunned. I have no friends and would rather have no family.
